provenance_scope: Source audit commit and published package integrity are pinned separately. Their build correspondence has not been independently attested.
geocoding_scope: The real upstream server can use Nominatim, Census.gov, and Open-Meteo. Each result identifies its source.
task_origin: OaK-authored real-service pilot requests, not an official benchmark or recorded user requests.
value_semantics: Displayed whole-degree daily highs, including the current local forecast date. No forecast values are supplied as task inputs.
installed_tree_hash_method: SHA256 of compact sorted JSON mapping every installed package-relative file path to its SHA256; transitive packages excluded.
